printf 'OS_VERSION_ID='
sed -n 's/^VERSION_ID=//p' /etc/os-release | tr -d '"'
printf 'BOOT_ID='
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'SERVICE_ACTIVE=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-active "$svc")"
printf 'SERVICE_ENABLED=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-enabled "$svc")"
printf 'SERVER_VERSION='
sudo "$cli" --batch --skip-column-names -e "SELECT VERSION()"
printf 'SERVER_PING='
sudo "$admin" ping
printf 'SCHEMA_CHARSET_COLLATION='
sudo "$cli" --batch --skip-column-names -e "SELECT CONCAT(DEFAULT_CHARACTER_SET_NAME,',',DEFAULT_COLLATION_NAME) FROM information_schema.SCHEMATA WHERE SCHEMA_NAME='$DB'"
printf 'OBJECT_COUNTS='
sudo "$cli" --batch --skip-column-names -e "SELECT CONCAT((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='$DB' AND TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE'),',',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.VIEWS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='$DB'),',',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TRIGGERS WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA='$DB'),',',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.ROUTINES WHERE ROUTINE_SCHEMA='$DB'),',',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.EVENTS WHERE EVENT_SCHEMA='$DB'))"
printf 'ROW_COUNTS='
sudo "$cli" --batch --skip-column-names "$DB" -e "SELECT CONCAT((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_events),',',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers),',',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders),',',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items))"
printf 'CONTENT_SHA256='
sudo "$cli" --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --batch --raw --skip-column-names "$DB" -e "SELECT event_id,entity_type,entity_id,action,event_time,details FROM audit_events ORDER BY event_id; SELECT customer_id,external_ref,full_name,email,status,created_at FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id; SELECT order_id,customer_id,order_ref,total_cents,status,created_at FROM orders ORDER BY order_id; SELECT order_id,line_no,sku,quantity,unit_price_cents FROM order_items ORDER BY order_id,line_no" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'METADATA_SHA256='
sudo "$cli" --batch --raw --skip-column-names -e "SELECT 'SCHEMA',SCHEMA_NAME,DEFAULT_CHARACTER_SET_NAME,DEFAULT_COLLATION_NAME FROM information_schema.SCHEMATA WHERE SCHEMA_NAME='$DB'; SELECT 'TABLE',TABLE_NAME,TABLE_TYPE,IFNULL(ENGINE,''),IFNULL(TABLE_COLLATION,'') FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='$DB' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME; SELECT 'COLUMN',TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION,COLUMN_NAME,COLUMN_TYPE,IS_NULLABLE,IFNULL(COLUMN_DEFAULT,'<NULL>'),EXTRA,IFNULL(CHARACTER_SET_NAME,''),IFNULL(COLLATION_NAME,'') FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='$DB' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION; SELECT 'INDEX',TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE,SEQ_IN_INDEX,COLUMN_NAME,IFNULL(SUB_PART,0),INDEX_TYPE FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='$DB' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,SEQ_IN_INDEX; SELECT 'CONSTRAINT',tc.TABLE_NAME,tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME,tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE,IFNULL(kcu.ORDINAL_POSITION,0),IFNULL(kcu.COLUMN_NAME,''),IFNULL(kcu.REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,''),IFNULL(kcu.REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME,'') FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS tc LEFT JOIN information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE kcu ON tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=kcu.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND tc.TABLE_NAME=kcu.TABLE_NAME AND tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME=kcu.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA='$DB' ORDER BY tc.TABLE_NAME,tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME,kcu.ORDINAL_POSITION; SELECT 'FKRULE',CONSTRAINT_NAME,TABLE_NAME,REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,UPDATE_RULE,DELETE_RULE FROM information_schema.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA='$DB' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,CONSTRAINT_NAME" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'CONSTRAINT_COUNTS='
sudo "$cli" --batch --skip-column-names -e "SELECT CONCAT(SUM(CONSTRAINT_TYPE='PRIMARY KEY'),',',SUM(CONSTRAINT_TYPE='UNIQUE'),',',SUM(CONSTRAINT_TYPE='FOREIGN KEY')) FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA='$DB'"
printf 'ORPHAN_COUNTS='
sudo "$cli" --batch --skip-column-names "$DB" -e "SELECT CONCAT((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL),',',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL))"
printf 'BUSINESS_TOTALS='
sudo "$cli" --batch --skip-column-names "$DB" -e "SELECT CONCAT(COUNT(*),',',SUM(total_cents),',',MIN(created_at),',',MAX(created_at)) FROM orders"
printf 'TABLE_HEALTH='
sudo "$check" --silent "$DB" && echo OK
